core_obligations: Explain the left hand side: the restriction $\alpha|_Z$ is obtained by functoriality for Hodge cohomology and $\gamma^p$ is applied to it by functoriality for cohomology (proof lines 5528-5535).

Explain the right hand side: pull back $\alpha$ along $i$ to $i^{-1}\Omega^p_{X/S}$, take the class $\gamma^0(1)$, form the cup product, and use the canonical maps into $R\mathcal{H}_Z(\Omega^{p+c}_{X/S})$ together with the vanishing above degree $c$ to land in $\mathcal{H}^c_Z(\Omega^{p+c}_{X/S})$; identify the resulting $i^{-1}\alpha \wedge \gamma^0(1)$ with the image of the cup product (proof lines 5537-5572).

Reduce the identity to the commutativity of the displayed diagram comparing $i^{-1}\Omega^p_X \otimes \Omega^0_Z \to i^{-1}\Omega^p_X \otimes \mathcal{H}^c_Z(\Omega^c_X)$ with the composite $\Omega^p_Z \to \Omega^p_Z \xrightarrow{\gamma^p} \mathcal{H}^c_Z(\Omega^{p+c}_X)$ via general properties of cup products (proof lines 5574-5589).

Record that the remaining computation for the maps $\gamma^j_{f_1,\ldots,f_c}$ is left to the reader, noting that these maps are chosen precisely so that the diagram commutes and so that $1$ maps to $\mathrm{d}f_1 \wedge \ldots \wedge \mathrm{d}f_c/(f_1 \ldots f_c)$ (proof lines 5590-5593).
proof_roadmap: The right hand side and the reduction to degree $c$ sheaves (proof lines 5537-5572).
The reduction to a commutative diagram (proof lines 5574-5589).
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the Gysin image of a restricted class with the cup product of the pulled back class with the Gysin class of the unit (statement lines 5519-5526). The proof explains both sides of the formula, using functoriality for the restriction and for the Gysin maps, the cup product for local cohomology with support and the vanishing of the support cohomology above the codimension to descend to the degree $c$ sheaves, and then reduces the claim to the commutativity of one diagram, the local verification of which is left to the reader with the maps chosen to make it hold. The reduction through the support cup product is the substance, so the claim is H2.
